name: foundry-dev
postStartCommand:
grep -qs azure-sp.env /root/.bashrc || printf '
# Foundry SP-Bootstrap (fnox/KV)
. /workspaces/.secrets/azure-sp.env
alias fnox=/workspaces/bin/fnox
' >> /root/.bashrc; if [ -f /workspaces/.secrets/azure-sp.env ] && ! az account show > /dev/null 2>&1; then . /workspaces/.secrets/azure-sp.env && az login --service-principal -u "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" -p "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" -t "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
